title: CatalogRevision
responsibility: Stores Git revision metadata and verification summaries in catalog_revisions through a supplied persistence adapter.

inputs.name: CatalogRevision.id
inputs.description: Primary key of a catalog_revisions row; CatalogWriteService sets it to the revision's commit SHA, a 40-character lowercase hex string. The model never generates it: create requires the caller to supply it, and find, update and delete pass it to the adapter unchanged.

inputs.name: CatalogRevision.subject
inputs.description: Commit subject line (git's %s field) that CatalogWriteService copies from the indexed revision. create requires it, update accepts it as an optional patch field, and the model passes it through without any check.
examples: Add evidence grid to the reports unit
Record the unit registry for the catalog

inputs.name: CatalogRevision.committedAt
inputs.description: Committer date that CatalogWriteService copies from the indexed revision, in the strict ISO 8601 form that git's %cI field produces. create requires it, update accepts it as an optional patch field, and the model neither parses nor validates it.

inputs.name: CatalogRevision.coverage
inputs.description: Coverage copied from the indexed revision by CatalogWriteService; indexedRevisionSchema (historyIndexTypes.ts) allows only verified, failed, invalid or unverified. The model keeps it as a plain string and neither restricts nor checks the value.

inputs.name: CatalogRevision.registryAvailable
inputs.description: CatalogWriteService stores registry?.available ?? false, so the value is true only when the commit's snapshot registry has available set to true, and false when no snapshot registry was supplied for the commit. The model does not interpret it and only copies it into the adapter call.

inputs.name: CatalogRevision.data
inputs.description: The complete IndexedRevision for the commit, as defined by the strict indexedRevisionSchema, which CatalogWriteService stores as the whole revision object. create requires it, update accepts it as an optional patch, and the adapter receives the same object reference because only the outer input is shallow-copied.

outputs.name: CatalogRevision.find
outputs.description: Resolves with the value the adapter's find returns for this table and id: a catalog_revisions row, or null when the adapter resolves with null. The model adds no lookup, conversion or fallback of its own.

errors.name: Persistence operation failure
errors.description: Exceptions the adapter throws synchronously propagate out of the call, and its promise rejections reach the caller unchanged, because the model has no try/catch and returns the adapter's promise directly.

errors.name: Caller input getter exception
errors.description: A getter that throws on the caller's findBy fields, create input or update input object makes that call throw synchronously, because the object spread that copies the input reads each own enumerable property before the adapter is invoked.

inputs.name: CatalogRevision.find.adapter
inputs.description: Persistence adapter whose find method is called with the catalog_revisions table name; the model never opens or closes a connection. A null or undefined adapter makes the call throw a TypeError synchronously, because the call reads the find method from it directly.

inputs.description: Row identity passed to adapter.find unchanged; CatalogWriteService sets it to a commit SHA, and the model does not generate or validate it.
